verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS work-management product like Jira, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or analytics opt-out, a usage-tracking control, or any related privacy setting. Audit trails, sandboxes and SSO are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
